To speed up audit, please: a) confirm Maria's email and cell by EOD Tue May 19; b) upload the board resolution to the Drive folder and reply-all with confirm; c) indicate whether the signer needs a witness/notary step.

4) Clean copies & retention: Neha will produce a "final clean packet" (PDF bundle with execution log) and upload to the secure S3 bucket and the shared Drive. We'll also include a certificate of incumbency and a timestamped clean copy. Expect delivery within 24 hours of the fully executed envelope.
